articles.title: U.S. charges 3 men with plotting multiple terrorist attacks, including planned attack against U.K. air base
articles.description: One of the men helped direct the planned attack against the air base while he was in a U.S. prison, according to a Justice Department indictment.

articles.title: World : 10 Police Personnel Killed In Militant Attack In NW Pakistan
articles.description: ISLAMABAD, Nov 11 (Bernama-Xinhua) -- At least 10 police personnel were killed in a militant attack on their convoy in Pakistan's northwest Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province on Wednesday, police sources said, reported Xinhua.

articles.title: Feds: Accused Iran-backed terrorist plotted UK air base attack from NYC prison
articles.description: A federal judge last week was skeptical that Mohammad Baqer Saad Dawood al-Saadi was using “coded” phone calls from jail to coordinate terror plots.

articles.title: Iran-backed militant helped plot attack on UK base
articles.description: US prosecutors say they have identified the jailed Iranian man who was behind a foiled plan to attack a Royal Air Force base in Britain.

articles.title: Iran-backed militant helped plot attack on UK's Fairford base from US jail, Justice Department says
articles.description: NEW YORK, Nov 10 - A member of an Iran-backed militia plotted to attack the RAF Fairford air base in Britain while detained in the US on criminal charges, the US Justice Department said on Tuesday.

articles.title: Terrorist who shot at Montreal Jewish school sentenced to 66 months in prison for 2023 attack
articles.description: Police responding to the shooting discovered bullet holes in the entrance door and spent shell casings on the ground. The building was unoccupied at the time, and no injuries were reported.

articles.title: Policeman martyred, 3 missing in terrorist attack on Hangu checkpost: DPO
articles.description: HANGU - A policeman was martyred and three others got missing after militants attacked on check post at Shah Almas Pir Pahari on Monday night.
